lead: `bun nv peek --locate Type::member` finds a call site or nothing, never the definition, when the member is on an inherent `impl`.
body: A member is written `fn of(` under `impl Registry`, so the qualified spelling only exists where somebody *calls* it: `--locate Registry::of` answers with a call in `crates/nvs-runtime/src/metrics.rs`, never the definition. Locate the bare name or the type instead, or take the file's outline with `bun nv peek --outline <file>` and read the region.
